title: Parsley Health footer
description: A deep forest footer: a social handle and 'Follow →' link over a wide social-feed slot, a clover rule, then the wordmark with a newsletter pill (bone field, clover button), share icons and a small compliance badge beside three columns of link groups with clover titles, a peach pill and an outlined pill; a second rule and right-aligned small legal links separated by thin bars. On phones it stacks: wordmark, link groups in two columns, pills, newsletter, icons, centred legal.
notes: a .dark scope: forest in both modes
the feed slot is a placeholder strip until media is passed in
social icons come in as nodes (lucide 1.x has no brand icons)
